purpose: Prospectively determine whether each deployed V1 market model is at least as accurate as its frozen devigged market benchmark on the opportunities selected by the production admission policy.

retrospective_evidence_exclusion.reason: The 354 rows and their outcomes were inspected before this protocol was frozen; they may justify the problem statement but may not select a threshold, parameter, or verdict.

economic_admission_contract.authority: Existing Recommendation Decision V4 five-state cashflow contract; this protocol does not select a new per-pick threshold.

cohort.window_start_rule: First frozen dynamic_prematch_evaluations row produced after deployment by evaluation_policy_version=candidate-eval.v2 and economic_admission_contract_version=w2.economic_admission.cashflow.v1.
include: final evaluated opportunity for fixture x market x registered slot
calibration_identity exactly equals the identity named by the eventual registry grant
model_identity and evaluation_policy_version exactly equal the identities named by the eventual registry grant
authoritative result confirmed after the evaluation was frozen
model and devigged market probabilities persisted before kickoff
exclude: any row evaluated under candidate-eval.v1 or another policy version
any row before the implementation deployment instant
rows whose calibration, model, policy, scoring, or market identity changed
rows without an authoritative settled result
cohort.identity_change_rule: Any model_identity, calibration_identity, evaluation_policy_version, economic admission contract version, scoring contract version, or market change invalidates pooling and starts a new cohort.

scoring.confidence_interval: deterministic 10000-replicate fixture-cluster bootstrap, one-sided 95% upper bound

sample_size.derivation: Without using observed retrospective variance, a bounded paired-loss planning bound for one-sided alpha=0.05 and epsilon=0.05 gives ceil(ln(1/0.05)/(2*0.05^2))=600 independent fixtures. Apply a frozen design-effect multiplier of 2 for within-fixture and schedule dependence and divide by 0.8 for unusable/identity-break attrition: ceil(600*2/0.8)=1500 per market.
sample_size.view_rule: Primary metrics may be viewed exactly once only when both markets have at least 1500 settled fixtures and the earliest evaluation timestamp has passed.

verdict.pass_rule: For ASIAN_HANDICAP and TOTALS separately, the one-sided 95% upper bound of mean(model_brier - market_brier) must be <= 0. Both markets must pass; results may not be pooled.
verdict.failure_rule: No grant is written. Do not change thresholds from this cohort. A changed model or admission policy requires a new preregistration and a new identity-isolated cohort.
verdict.scope: A pass authorises only the exact bound model x calibration x market x evaluation-policy x scoring-contract identities. It does not certify profitability.

interim_safety_view.trigger: Either market has point estimate mean(model_brier - market_brier) > 0.10.

registration_evidence_required: metrics including point estimate and one-sided upper bound
prohibitions: No replayed decision may enter the forward cohort.
No P&L, hit rate, current picks, or 1X2 metric may grant admission.
No ledger record may be edited, deleted, revoked, or inserted through a database or environment variable.
No deployment is authorised by this preregistration.
